newsitem.title: UK: GEC extends gains on merger talk.
newsitem.headline: GEC extends gains on merger talk.

text.p: Shares in General Electric Co Plc extended gains on Tuesday as talk about a possible merger with rival British Aerospace Plc would lure investors, traders said.
By 1340 GMT, GEC was up 12-1/2p to 349p in a volume of 14 million shares, making it the most actively traded stock in London.
GEC was up for the third consecutive day after the stock hit a year's low of 327p on June 5.
"The reports of closer ties between GEC and British Aerospace have generated much interest", one trader said.

Earlier, the Guardian newspaper said senior British Aerospace executives were eyeing a link-up in the wake of the Socialist victory in France, which has cast doubts over the speed of the new government's privatisation plans.
These include St Nationale Industrielle Aerospatiale, a key BAe partner in the Airbus consortium, and Thomson-CSF, where delay could slow wider consolidation within the European defence industry.
Speculation of a merger between the two British groups has been around for years, with talks earlier in the year apparently foundering on the issue of price.
BAe shares were down 11-1/2 p to 13.46-1/2 stg, retreating from its high of 1368p in the opening.
